result: In `skid_buffer_core`, replace `occupancy` with two valid bits for the front and back entries, using only legal states for empty, one-word, and full; derive `out_valid` from front-valid and `in_ready` from back-valid plus `out_ready`. Update those bits for push-only, pop-only, simultaneous push/pop, and reset while preserving the existing front/back data movement, full-width payloads, stall stability, and one-word-per-cycle throughput. Keep data registers unreset if they are unreset in the incumbent, retain the top’s `// @latency 1`, and preserve all ports and cycle behavior.
